messages:
TWINS~TORI~&~TIA sent out
Oricorio and Oricorio!

A tailwind started blowing
on the~opposing side!

Gyarados’s Gyaradosite is reacting
to BRENDAN’s Mega

Gyarados has Mega Evolved
into Mega Gyarados!

The opposing Oricorio’s
HP was restored.

The opposing Oricorio avoided
the attack!

The opposing Oricorio flinched
and couldn’t move!

Togekiss became the center
of attention!

You have no more Pokémon
that can fight!
You were overwhelmed by your defeat!
